title: WP License Captain catalog file (wplc-catalog.json), format 1
description: One license product of a vendor: product key, entitlement prefix, name and the entitlements its add-on checks. See docs/manual/03-catalog-files.md. Unknown fields are ignored by the server.

product_key.description: License product key: what the add-on sends to the server and what the shop enters on the license product.

prefix.description: Part of every entitlement key before the first dot. May be left out when the file lists at least one entitlement; required otherwise.

name.description: Name of the product, shown as the heading of its entitlements in the product editor.

status.description: available: the product is released and the product editor suggests its key. planned: the key is reserved, nothing is offered. Default: available.

locale.description: en (required, the fallback) or a WordPress locale such as de_DE or de_DE_formal.

label.description: Plain text, one line, no markup. A string is read as the English text.

description.description: Plain text, no markup. A string is read as the English text.

key.description: Entitlement key the add-on checks. Starts with the prefix and a dot; lowercase snake_case after it is recommended.

status.description: available: a released version of the add-on checks this key; the product editor offers it. planned: reserved, not offered. Default: available.
